svg.text: A ditched aeroplane's heave and pitch (WATER-LOOK G2094) - STAGED INLINE (node, tools/ditch_osc.js: placed over the SEA lane, no page, no drawn field)
Cub, ditched at 22 m/s, 1.5 m/s sink, throttle CLOSED
heave zeta 0.050, period 1.22 s; pitch zeta 0.064; thrust after the stop up to 0 N
Cub, the same ditch, throttle LEFT at 0.6 (a pilot that keeps power)
heave zeta 0.055, period 1.16 s; thrust after the stop up to 729 N
metal Cessna, ditched at 25 m/s, 1.5 m/s sink, throttle closed
heave zeta 0.037, period 1.63 s; pitch zeta 0.026; thrust after the stop up to 0 N
Cessna floats, a hard touchdown: 15 m/s, 2.3 m/s sink, throttle closed

blue: the CG's height over the water (heave) red: pitch orange: the thrust applied dashed: the aeroplane stopped (ground speed under 1 m/s)
